snippet.title: Gothic II Complete Classic | Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Gothic II Complete Classic is OUT NOW on PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, XBOX One, and XBOX Series X|S.

You have torn down the magical barrier and freed the prisoners of the Valley of Mines. Now the former convicts roam the forests and mountains, causing trouble around the city of Khorinis. The town militia is stretched thin, and outside the city walls, travelers are largely defenseless against bandit attacks. Are you prepared to continue the story of the Nameless Hero?
